title: Add an MCP server
intro: You're adding a remote issue-tracker server at https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Pick a scope and see who gets it.

show.title: Just you, in this project
show.detail: Local is the default scope. The server is available only to you, and only in this project.

trace.text: claude mcp add --transport http tracker https://mcp.example.com/mcp
Saved for you in this project only.

show.title: Shared through .mcp.json
show.detail: The server is written to .mcp.json at the project root, which you can commit. Teammates must approve a project server before it runs.

trace.text: claude mcp add --transport http --scope project tracker https://mcp.example.com/mcp
Sees it as pending and approves it on first use.

show.title: You, in every project
show.detail: User scope makes the server available to you in all your projects.

trace.text: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user tracker https://mcp.example.com/mcp
Available in every project you open.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose a scope for the server.

quiz.question: You clone a repository whose .mcp.json lists a server. What happens the first time you run Claude Code?
options: It waits until you approve it
quiz.explanation: Servers from a project's .mcp.json stay pending until you approve them, so a repository can't connect tools on its own.
